description: This line plot compares the time cost in seconds for two configurations—“w/o Pre-computation” (blue line) and “w Pre-computation” (orange line)—as a function of the number of papers processed, which is plotted on the x-axis labeled “Paper Number” and uses a logarithmic scale ranging from 1 to 256 with tick labels at intervals of powers of two (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256). The y-axis, labeled “Time Cost (s)”, is linear and spans from 0 to 35 seconds. The blue line, representing the “w/o Pre-computation” scenario, starts at approximately 1.5 seconds for one paper and exhibits a steep, accelerating increase, reaching about 35 seconds at 256 papers. In contrast, the orange line, representing the “w Pre-computation” scenario, remains nearly flat at approximately 1.5 seconds across the entire range of paper numbers, indicating minimal change in time cost regardless of the number of papers processed.
